11 # Extreme sets
12 
13 This file defines extreme sets and extreme points for sets in a module.
14 
15 An extreme set of `A` is a subset of `A` that is as far as it can get in any outward direction: If
16 point `x` is in it and point `y ∈ A`, then the line passing through `x` and `y` leaves `A` at `x`.
17 This is an analytic notion of "being on the side of". It is weaker than being exposed (see
18 `IsExposed.isExtreme`).
19 
20 ## Main declarations
21 
22 * `IsExtreme 𝕜 A B`: States that `B` is an extreme set of `A` (in the literature, `A` is often
23   implicit).
24 * `Set.extremePoints 𝕜 A`: Set of extreme points of `A` (corresponding to extreme singletons).
25 * `Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_diff`: A useful equivalent condition to being an extreme
26   point: `x` is an extreme point iff `A \ {x}` is convex.
27 
28 ## Implementation notes
29 
30 The exact definition of extremeness has been carefully chosen so as to make as many lemmas
31 unconditional (in particular, the Krein-Milman theorem doesn't need the set to be convex!).
32 In practice, `A` is often assumed to be a convex set.
33 
34 ## References
35 
36 See chapter 8 of [Barry Simon, *Convexity*][simon2011]
37 
38 ## TODO
39

41 -/

52 variable (𝕜) [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [SMul 𝕜 E]
53 
54 /-- A set `B` is an extreme subset of `A` if `B ⊆ A` and all points of `B` only belong to open
55 segments whose ends are in `B`.
56 
57 Our definition only requires that the left endpoint of the segment lies in `B`,
58 but by symmetry of open segments, the right endpoint must also lie in `B`.
59 See `IsExtreme.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment`. -/
60 @[mk_iff]
61 structure IsExtreme (A B : Set E) : Prop where
62   subset : B ⊆ A
63   left_mem_of_mem_openSegment : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ A → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ A →
64     ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ∈ B → z ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y → x ∈ B
65 
66 /-- A point `x` is an extreme point of a set `A` if `x` belongs to no open segment with ends in
67 `A`, except for the obvious `openSegment x x`. -/
68 def Set.extremePoints (A : Set E) : Set E :=
69   {x ∈ A | ∀ ⦃x₁⦄, x₁ ∈ A → ∀ ⦃x₂⦄, x₂ ∈ A → x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x}
70 
71 @[refl]
72 protected theorem IsExtreme.refl (A : Set E) : IsExtreme 𝕜 A A :=
73   ⟨Subset.rfl, fun _ hx₁A _ _ _ _ _ ↦ hx₁A⟩
74 
75 variable {𝕜} {A B C : Set E} {x : E}
76 
77 protected theorem IsExtreme.rfl : IsExtreme 𝕜 A A :=
78   IsExtreme.refl 𝕜 A
79 
80 theorem IsExtreme.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment (h : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) {y z : E} (hx : x ∈ A)
81     (hy : y ∈ A) (hz : z ∈ B) (hzxy : z ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x y) : y ∈ B :=
82   h.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hy hx hz <| by rwa [openSegment_symm]
83 
84 @[trans]
85 protected theorem IsExtreme.trans (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) (hBC : IsExtreme 𝕜 B C) :
86     IsExtreme 𝕜 A C := by
87   refine ⟨hBC.subset.trans hAB.subset, fun x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x hxC hx ↦ ?_⟩
88   exact hBC.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment
89     (hAB.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A (hBC.subset hxC) hx)
90     (hAB.right_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A (hBC.subset hxC) hx) hxC hx
91 
92 protected theorem IsExtreme.antisymm : Std.Antisymm (IsExtreme 𝕜 : Set E → Set E → Prop) :=
93   ⟨fun _ _ hAB hBA ↦ Subset.antisymm hBA.1 hAB.1⟩
94 
95 instance : IsPartialOrder (Set E) (IsExtreme 𝕜) where
96   refl := IsExtreme.refl 𝕜
97   trans _ _ _ := IsExtreme.trans
98   __ := IsExtreme.antisymm
99 
100 theorem IsExtreme.inter (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) (hAC : IsExtreme 𝕜 A C) :
101     IsExtreme 𝕜 A (B ∩ C) := by
102   use Subset.trans inter_subset_left hAB.1
103   rintro x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x ⟨hxB, hxC⟩ hx
104   exact ⟨hAB.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A hxB hx,
105     hAC.left_mem_of_mem_openSegment hx₁A hx₂A hxC hx⟩
106 
107 protected theorem IsExtreme.mono (hAC : IsExtreme 𝕜 A C) (hBA : B ⊆ A) (hCB : C ⊆ B) :
108     IsExtreme 𝕜 B C :=
109   ⟨hCB, fun _ hx₁B _ hx₂B _ hxC hx ↦ hAC.2 (hBA hx₁B) (hBA hx₂B) hxC hx⟩
110 
111 theorem isExtreme_iInter {ι : Sort*} [Nonempty ι] {F : ι → Set E}
112     (hAF : ∀ i : ι, IsExtreme 𝕜 A (F i)) : IsExtreme 𝕜 A (⋂ i : ι, F i) := by
113   inhabit ι
114   refine ⟨iInter_subset_of_subset default (hAF default).1, fun x₁ hx₁A x₂ hx₂A x hxF hx ↦ ?_⟩
115   rw [mem_iInter] at hxF ⊢
116   exact fun i ↦ (hAF i).2 hx₁A hx₂A (hxF i) hx
117 
118 theorem isExtreme_biInter {F : Set (Set E)} (hF : F.Nonempty) (hA : ∀ B ∈ F, IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
119     IsExtreme 𝕜 A (⋂ B ∈ F, B) := by
120   haveI := hF.to_subtype
121   simpa only [iInter_subtype] using isExtreme_iInter fun i : F ↦ hA _ i.2
122 
123 theorem isExtreme_sInter {F : Set (Set E)} (hF : F.Nonempty) (hAF : ∀ B ∈ F, IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
124     IsExtreme 𝕜 A (⋂₀ F) := by simpa [sInter_eq_biInter] using isExtreme_biInter hF hAF
125 
126 /-- A point `x` is an extreme point of a set `A`
127 iff `x ∈ A` and for any `x₁`, `x₂` such that `x` belongs to the open segment `(x₁, x₂)`,
128 we have `x₁ = x` and `x₂ = x`.
129 
130 We used to use the RHS as the definition of `extremePoints`.
131 However, the conclusion `x₂ = x` is redundant,
132 so we changed the definition to the RHS of `mem_extremePoints_iff_left`. -/
133 theorem mem_extremePoints : x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔
134     x ∈ A ∧ ∀ᵉ (x₁ ∈ A) (x₂ ∈ A), x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x ∧ x₂ = x := by
135   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx ↦ ⟨h.2 hx₁ hx₂ hx, ?_⟩⟩,
136     fun h ↦ ⟨h.1, fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx ↦ (h.2 x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx).1⟩⟩
137   apply h.2 hx₂ hx₁
138   rwa [openSegment_symm]
139 
140 /-- A point `x` is an extreme point of a set `A`
141 iff `x ∈ A` and for any `x₁`, `x₂` such that `x` belongs to the open segment `(x₁, x₂)`,
142 we have `x₁ = x`. -/
143 theorem mem_extremePoints_iff_left : x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔
144     x ∈ A ∧ ∀ x₁ ∈ A, ∀ x₂ ∈ A, x ∈ openSegment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x :=
145   .rfl
146 
147 /-- x is an extreme point to A iff {x} is an extreme set of A. -/
148 @[simp] lemma isExtreme_singleton : IsExtreme 𝕜 A {x} ↔ x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 := by
149   simp [isExtreme_iff, extremePoints]
150 
151 alias ⟨IsExtreme.mem_extremePoints, _⟩ := isExtreme_singleton
152 
153 theorem extremePoints_subset : A.extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ A :=
154   fun _ hx ↦ hx.1
155 
156 @[simp]
157 theorem extremePoints_empty : (∅ : Set E).extremePoints 𝕜 = ∅ :=
158   subset_empty_iff.1 extremePoints_subset
159 
160 @[simp]
161 theorem extremePoints_singleton : ({x} : Set E).extremePoints 𝕜 = {x} :=
162   extremePoints_subset.antisymm <| singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨mem_singleton x, fun _ hx₁ _ _ _ ↦ hx₁⟩
163 
164 theorem inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset (hBA : B ⊆ A) :
165     B ∩ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ B.extremePoints 𝕜 :=
166   fun _ ⟨hxB, hxA⟩ ↦ ⟨hxB, fun _ hx₁ _ hx₂ hx ↦ hxA.2 (hBA hx₁) (hBA hx₂) hx⟩
167 
168 theorem IsExtreme.extremePoints_subset_extremePoints (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
169     B.extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ A.extremePoints 𝕜 :=
170   fun _ ↦ by simpa only [← isExtreme_singleton] using hAB.trans
171 
172 theorem IsExtreme.extremePoints_eq (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
173     B.extremePoints 𝕜 = B ∩ A.extremePoints 𝕜 :=
174   Subset.antisymm (fun _ hx ↦ ⟨hx.1, hAB.extremePoints_subset_extremePoints hx⟩)
175     (inter_extremePoints_subset_extremePoints_of_subset hAB.1)
176 
177 @[nontriviality]
178 lemma Set.extremePoints_eq_self [Subsingleton E] (A : Set E) : Set.extremePoints 𝕜 A = A :=
179   subset_antisymm extremePoints_subset fun _ h ↦ ⟨h, fun _ _ _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim ..⟩
180 
181 end SMul

183 section OrderedSemiring
184 
185 variable [Semiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup F] [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)]
186   [Module 𝕜 E] [Module 𝕜 F] [∀ i, Module 𝕜 (M i)] {A B : Set E}
187 
188 theorem IsExtreme.convex_diff [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) (hAB : IsExtreme 𝕜 A B) :
189     Convex 𝕜 (A \ B) :=
190   convex_iff_openSegment_subset.2 fun _ ⟨hx₁A, hx₁B⟩ _ ⟨hx₂A, _⟩ _ hx ↦
191     ⟨hA.openSegment_subset hx₁A hx₂A hx, fun hxB ↦ hx₁B (hAB.2 hx₁A hx₂A hxB hx)⟩
192 
193 @[simp]
194 theorem extremePoints_prod (s : Set E) (t : Set F) :
195     (s ×ˢ t).extremePoints 𝕜 = s.extremePoints 𝕜 ×ˢ t.extremePoints 𝕜 := by
196   ext ⟨x, y⟩
197   refine (and_congr_right fun hx ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩).trans and_and_and_comm
198   · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, hx'⟩
199     ext
200     · exact h.1 hx₁.1 hx₂.1 ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congrArg Prod.fst hx'⟩
201     · exact h.2 hx₁.2 hx₂.2 ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, congrArg Prod.snd hx'⟩
202   · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx_fst
203     refine congrArg Prod.fst (h (mk_mem_prod hx₁ hx.2) (mk_mem_prod hx₂ hx.2) ?_)
204     rw [← Prod.image_mk_openSegment_left]
205     exact mem_image_of_mem _ hx_fst
206   · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx_snd
207     refine congrArg Prod.snd (h (mk_mem_prod hx.1 hx₁) (mk_mem_prod hx.1 hx₂) ?_)
208     rw [← Prod.image_mk_openSegment_right]
209     exact mem_image_of_mem _ hx_snd
210 
211 @[simp]
212 theorem extremePoints_pi (s : ∀ i, Set (M i)) :
213     (univ.pi s).extremePoints 𝕜 = univ.pi fun i ↦ (s i).extremePoints 𝕜 := by
214   classical
215   ext x
216   simp only [mem_extremePoints_iff_left, mem_univ_pi, @forall_and ι]
217   refine and_congr_right fun hx ↦ ⟨fun h i ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
218   · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hi
219     rw [← update_self i x₁ x, h (update x i x₁) _ (update x i x₂)]
220     · rintro j
221       obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*]
222     · rw [← Pi.image_update_openSegment]
223       exact ⟨_, hi, update_eq_self _ _⟩
224     · rintro j
225       obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*]
226   · rintro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
227     ext i
228     exact h _ _ (hx₁ _) _ (hx₂ _) ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
229 
230 end OrderedSemiring

232 section OrderedRing
233 variable {L : Type*} [Ring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [IsOrderedRing 𝕜]
234   [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 F]
235   [EquivLike L E F] [LinearEquivClass L 𝕜 E F]
236 
237 lemma image_extremePoints (f : L) (s : Set E) :
238     f '' extremePoints 𝕜 s = extremePoints 𝕜 (f '' s) := by
239   ext b
240   obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := EquivLike.surjective f b
241   have : ∀ x y, f '' openSegment 𝕜 x y = openSegment 𝕜 (f x) (f y) :=
242     image_openSegment _ (LinearMapClass.linearMap f).toAffineMap
243   simp only [mem_extremePoints, (EquivLike.surjective f).forall,
244     (EquivLike.injective f).mem_set_image, (EquivLike.injective f).eq_iff, ← this]
245 
246 end OrderedRing
247 
248 section LinearOrderedRing
249 
250 variable [Ring 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E]
251 variable [DenselyOrdered 𝕜] [IsTorsionFree 𝕜 E] {A : Set E} {x : E}
252 
253 /-- A useful restatement using `segment`: `x` is an extreme point iff the only (closed) segments
254 that contain it are those with `x` as one of their endpoints. -/
255 theorem mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment : x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔
256     x ∈ A ∧ ∀ᵉ (x₁ ∈ A) (x₂ ∈ A), x ∈ segment 𝕜 x₁ x₂ → x₁ = x ∨ x₂ = x := by
257   rw [mem_extremePoints]
258   refine and_congr_right fun hxA ↦ forall₄_congr fun x₁ h₁ x₂ h₂ ↦ ?_
259   constructor
260   · rw [← insert_endpoints_openSegment]
261     rintro H (rfl | rfl | hx)
262     exacts [Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl, Or.inl <| (H hx).1]
263   · intro H hx
264     rcases H (openSegment_subset_segment _ _ _ hx) with (rfl | rfl)
265     exacts [⟨rfl, (left_mem_openSegment_iff.1 hx).symm⟩, ⟨right_mem_openSegment_iff.1 hx, rfl⟩]
266 
267 theorem Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_diff (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) :
268     x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔ x ∈ A ∧ Convex 𝕜 (A \ {x}) := by
269   use fun hx ↦ ⟨hx.1, (isExtreme_singleton.2 hx).convex_diff hA⟩
270   rintro ⟨hxA, hAx⟩
271   refine mem_extremePoints_iff_forall_segment.2 ⟨hxA, fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hx ↦ ?_⟩
272   rw [convex_iff_segment_subset] at hAx
273   by_contra! h
274   exact (hAx ⟨hx₁, fun hx₁ ↦ h.1 (mem_singleton_iff.2 hx₁)⟩
275       ⟨hx₂, fun hx₂ ↦ h.2 (mem_singleton_iff.2 hx₂)⟩ hx).2 rfl
276 
277 theorem Convex.mem_extremePoints_iff_mem_diff_convexHull_diff (hA : Convex 𝕜 A) :
278     x ∈ A.extremePoints 𝕜 ↔ x ∈ A \ convexHull 𝕜 (A \ {x}) := by
279   rw [hA.mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_diff, hA.convex_remove_iff_notMem_convexHull_remove,
280     mem_diff]
281 
282 theorem extremePoints_convexHull_subset : (convexHull 𝕜 A).extremePoints 𝕜 ⊆ A := by
283   rintro x hx
284   rw [(convex_convexHull 𝕜 _).mem_extremePoints_iff_convex_diff] at hx
285   by_contra h
286   exact (convexHull_min (subset_diff.2 ⟨subset_convexHull 𝕜 _, disjoint_singleton_right.2 h⟩) hx.2
287     hx.1).2 rfl
288 
289 end LinearOrderedRing
